blocks.text: Josh Cullen delivers a powerhouse performance in his latest single, ‘Like Me,’ a high-energy collaboration with Korean singer and rapper Jay Park. Blending sharp storytelling, smooth vocals, and show-stopping choreography, the track showcases an artist at the top of his game. At a press conference on September 25 at 1Z Entertainment Studio, Cullen described ‘Like Me’ as “a very unapologetic song.” The track reflects his personal journey as he navigates industry pressures and stays determined to stand out in an era when formulaic approaches are the norm.
